distinguishing_fact: Subheading 7419.20.00 covers articles cast, molded, stamped or forged, but not further worked; the subject snap hooks are multi-component, assembled hardware featuring a spring snap mechanism and a swiveling eye, constituting further working.
reasoning: The merchandise is Model 225B brass snap hooks composed of 61% copper, 35% zinc, and 4% other material. Under Note 5 to Section XV, an alloy of base metals is classified as the metal which predominates by weight, making this an article of copper under Chapter 74. Under GRI 1 and Explanatory Notes to heading 7326 and 7419, snap hooks with spring safety closures and swiveling eyes are classified as other articles of base metal under heading 7419. Within heading 7419, they are not merely cast or forged (7419.20.00) but are assembled articles classified under subheading 7419.80, specifically under the residual 8-digit tariff line 7419.80.50.

citations.quote: an alloy of base metals of this section is to be classified as an alloy of the metal which predominates by weight over each of the other metals.
